preconditions.description: The number of queries q must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 50 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for n in [int(line.split()[0])])
preconditions.description: For each query, the array size n must be between 1 and 50 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= s <= 200 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for s in [int(line.split()[1])])
preconditions.description: For each query, the sum s must be between 0 and 200 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= 2000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for k in [int(line.split()[2])])
preconditions.description: For each query, the sum of absolute differences k must be between 0 and 2000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == n or output_line.strip() == '-1' for output_line in stdout.splitlines() for n in [int(stdin.splitlines()[i+1].split()[0]) for i in range(q)])
postconditions.description: For each query, the output line must either contain exactly n space-separated integers or be '-1'.

postconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= int(x) for x in output_line.split()) if output_line.strip() != '-1' else True for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: All elements in the output array must be non-negative integers.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(int(x) for x in output_line.split()) == s if output_line.strip() != '-1' else True for output_line, (n, s, k) in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [(int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1]), int(line.split()[2])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each query, if the output is not '-1', the sum of the array elements must equal s.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(abs(int(output_line.split()[i]) - int(output_line.split()[j])) for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n)) == k if output_line.strip() != '-1' else True for output_line, (n, s, k) in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [(int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1]), int(line.split()[2])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each query, if the output is not '-1', the sum of absolute differences between each pair of elements must equal k.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line == '-1' or all(int(output_line.split()[i]) <= int(output_line.split()[j]) for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n)) or all(int(output_line.split()[i]) >= int(output_line.split()[j]) for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n)) for output_line in stdout.splitlines() for n in [int(stdin.splitlines()[stdout.splitlines().index(output_line)+1].split()[0])])
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the array must be either non-decreasing or non-increasing (lexicographically smallest implies non-decreasing).

postconditions.expression: all(output_line == '-1' or output_line == ' '.join(map(str, sorted([int(x) for x in output_line.split()], reverse=False))) for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip() != '-1')
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', it must be the lexicographically smallest array satisfying the conditions.
